A rug pull is when the people behind a token suddenly take the money out of its trading pool or dump their huge share, so the price crashes to almost zero and holders cannot sell for real money. Warning signs: liquidity not locked or burned, a few wallets holding most of the supply, the creator can still mint new tokens or freeze wallets, and hype with promises of fast profit. Check any token for free with the Token Checkup at /hq.html#checkup and see live totals on /radar.html.
honeypot cannot sell can't sell sell blocked

A honeypot is a token you can buy but not sell, because the contract blocks selling or the sell tax is close to 100%. A sign: many buys and zero sells. The MAIGA Radar shows this flag as 'buys but zero sells' (/radar.html).
liquidity lock locked burned lp pool

Liquidity is the money in a token's trading pool that makes buying and selling possible. If it is locked or burned, the creator cannot simply pull it out. Unlocked liquidity is one of the biggest rug pull warning signs. Thin liquidity (under about $10,000) also means the price can crash on a small sale.
seed phrase private key recovery phrase wallet secret words

Your seed phrase (recovery phrase) and private key give full control of your wallet. Never type them on a website, never send them to anyone, never share a screenshot. No real support team, airdrop or app will ever ask for them. Anyone who asks is a scammer.
mint authority freeze authority mint freeze

On Solana, mint authority means the creator can create new tokens at any time (diluting holders); freeze authority means they can freeze your tokens so you cannot sell. Safer tokens have both revoked. The Token Checkup at /hq.html#checkup shows both.
airdrop giveaway free tokens claim drainer

Most surprise 'free airdrop' or 'claim your tokens' links are wallet drainers: connecting and signing gives the scammer permission to empty your wallet. Never connect your wallet to a link you got in a DM, comment or random post.
dm direct message support team admin impersonation telegram whatsapp
Scammers pretend to be support, admins or famous people in DMs and move you to Telegram or WhatsApp. Real teams never DM first and never ask for keys, seed phrases or payments. Block and report.
pump dump pump and dump pumped

A pump and dump is when a group hypes a token so others buy, then sells everything at the top. A price jump of +300% in a day is a red flag, not a promise. Most new meme tokens lose almost all their value.
